CONVERSATION.NAME: Get Melissa to Forgive Justin.
CONVERSATION.DESCRIP: Melissa thinks Justin is a dilettante who used Matthew and ditched him as soon as he lost interest in art. Try and convince her she's wrong about him, that he's a good guy and she is over-reacting.

CARD.NAME: He used Matthew
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Matthew is a great guy, and Justin only talked to him to learn about art. As soon as he was done using him, he stopped coming around.

CARD.NAME: Justin has ADD
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin can't stay interested in one thing longer than 10 seconds. He's got the attention span of a gnat.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: Even the motorcycle isn't real
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Perfect example -- Justin only got that motorcycle when he was going through some tough guy biker phase. I think the bikers saw right through him.

CARD.NAME: Rumor: No wonder Stefanie dumped him.
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Justin is just so aimless. So pointless. It's no wonder Stefanie dumped him and traded up.
